I forgot to mention that the @ flag should cause scaling by powers of 2^10
instead of 10^3:  (format () "~Ubits, ~:Ub, ~@Ubits, ~:@Ub" 65536 65536 65536 65536)
   =>  "65.536 kilobits, 65.536 Kb, 64.0 kilobits, 64.0 Kb"
--Q
